headline: Exchange Inflows Fall To 1,473.2 Million Dollars From 1,717.2 Million
narrative: The 24-hour exchange inflow fell to 1,473.2 million dollars, 0.5419 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from 1,717.2 million dollars at 0.6326 percent. Binance took in 1,471.2 million dollars of the 1,473.2 million dollar intake, while Bitget shed 61.3 million dollars and OKX shed 43.8 million dollars. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and the Bitget and OKX prints are money leaving those venues.
author: jordan
